title: Standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
contract_text:
MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of October 1, 2026, by and between Apex Analytics Inc. ("Disclosing Party") and Zenith Data Systems Corp. ("Receiving Party").

Section 1. Definition of Confidential Information. Confidential Information refers to non-public technical, commercial, or operational information disclosed by either party to the other.

Section 2. Standard of Care. The Receiving Party agrees to protect Confidential Information using the same degree of care it uses for its own confidential materials, but not less than reasonable care.

Section 3. Term and Return. This Agreement shall remain in effect for two (2) years. Upon written request, Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy all tangible copies of Confidential Information.

Section 4. Limitation of Liability. Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed fifty thousand dollars ($50,000).

Section 5. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.

title: Standard Enterprise SaaS Agreement
contract_text:
ENTERPRISE SOFTWARE-AS-A-SERVICE AGREEMENT
This SaaS Agreement is made effective November 1, 2026, between CloudScale Operations LLC ("Vendor") and Global Retail Partners Inc. ("Customer").

Section 1. Subscription Services. Vendor grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable subscription to access the CloudScale Platform during the Subscription Term.

Section 2. Fees and Payment. Customer shall pay all subscription fees within thirty (30) days of invoice date. Late invoices accrue interest at 1.0% per month.

Section 3. Service Level Commitment. Vendor warrants 99.9% monthly availability, excluding scheduled maintenance. Outages exceeding SLA thresholds qualify for service credits.

Section 4. Limitation of Liability. Each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid by Customer in the preceding twelve (12) months.

Section 5. Term and Termination. The initial term is twelve (12) months. Either party may terminate for material breach upon thirty (30) days written notice and opportunity to cure.

Section 6. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.
